title: Cardano’s 2027 budget proposal would let funding stewards seek grants too
summary:
Proposed stewards could influence assessments while DReps retain spending votes and a direct funding route awaits its allocation.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: A proposed 2027 budget for Cardano would allow funding stewards to also seek grants. While DReps will continue to hold spending votes, these proposed stewards could potentially influence assessments as a direct funding route awaits its future allocation.
content_ta: Cardano-ன் 2027-ம் ஆண்டுக்கான வரவு-செலவுத் திட்ட முன்மொழிவின்படி, நிதிப் பொறுப்பாளர்கள் (funding stewards) தங்களும் நிதியுதவி கோர அனுமதிக்கப்படுவார்கள். DReps அமைப்பு செலவினங்களுக்கான வாக்களிப்பு அதிகாரத்தைத் தொடரும் அதேவேளையில், இந்த முன்மொழியப்பட்ட பொறுப்பாளர்கள் மதிப்பீடுகளில் செல்வாக்கு செலுத்தலாம்.

title: XRP Ledger Reviews Two Token-Authorization Fixes Ahead of Any Validator Vote
summary: Two open XRP Ledger proposals address authorization checks for liquidity-pool tokens and existing trust-line balances. The changes remain under review and are not active network rules.
content: Two proposals for the XRP Ledger are currently under review, focusing on authorization checks for liquidity-pool tokens and existing trust-line balances. These proposed fixes are still being evaluated by the community and developers. They have not yet been put to a validator vote and are not active network rules.
content_ta: XRP Ledger-க்கான இரண்டு புதிய முன்மொழிவுகள் தற்போது பரிசீலனையில் உள்ளன. இவை liquidity-pool டோக்கன்கள் மற்றும் ஏற்கனவே உள்ள trust-line இருப்புகளுக்கான அங்கீகார சோடிப்புகளை மையமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளன. இந்த மாற்றங்கள் இன்னும் மதிப்பீட்டில் உள்ளன. இவை இன்னும் validator வாக்கெடுப்புக்கு வரவில்லை மற்றும் செயலில் உள்ள நெட்வொர்க் விதிகள் அல்ல.

title: South Korea plans to nearly double AI spending to 21.3 trillion won
summary:
South Korea's AI budget surge aims to enhance global competitiveness, foster domestic innovation, and strengthen its tech infrastructure.
The post South Korea plans to nearly double AI spending to 21.3 trillion won appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: South Korea has announced plans to nearly double its spending on artificial intelligence, raising the budget to 21.3 trillion won. This significant financial boost is designed to enhance the country's global competitiveness, foster domestic technological innovation, and strengthen its overall tech infrastructure as the global AI landscape rapidly expands.
content_ta: South Korea-ல் AI துறைக்கான செலவினங்களை கிட்டத்தட்ட இரண்டு மடங்காக அதிகரித்து, 21.3 டிரில்லியன் வோன் நிதி ஒதுக்கீடு செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது. நாட்டின் உலகளாவிய போட்டித்தன்மையை மேம்படுத்தவும், உள்நாட்டு தொழில்நுட்ப புதுமைகளை வளர்க்கவும், டெக் உள்கட்டமைப்பை வலுப்படுத்தவும் இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers
summary:
The post THORChain Halts Trading On 10 Blockchains After Ethereum Reorg Triggers 10 ETH Overpayment appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News
THORChain has paused trading on most of its supported blockchains after an Ethereum block reorganisation caused it to pay out 10 ETH it never received. At 11:34 UTC on October 31, a one-block reorg on Ethereum dropped a 10 ETH deposit that THORChain had already counted. The swap missed its price limit and was refunded, …
content: Decentralized liquidity protocol THORChain halted trading across multiple supported blockchains following an Ethereum block reorganisation. The network bug triggered an accidental 10 ETH overpayment after a one-block reorg dropped a legitimate deposit. The system missed its price limit during the incident, prompting developers to pause operations to address the technical flaw and secure user funds.
content_ta: Ethereum பிளாக் ரீஆர்கனைசேஷன் (reorganisation) காரணமாக ஏற்பட்ட பக் (bug) காரணமாக, THORChain தனது பிளாக்செயின் வர்த்தகத்தை தற்காலிகமாக நிறுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்தத் தொழில்நுட்பக் கோளாறால் 10 ETH அதிகமாக வழங்கப்பட்டதை அடுத்து, டெவலப்பர்கள் பாதுகாப்பு நடவடிக்கையாக வர்த்தகத்தை முடக்கியுள்ளனர்.

title: SemiAnalysis unveils GDPx benchmark, and the best AI model scores 12%
summary:
The GDPx benchmark highlights the nascent stage of AI's general agentic capabilities, underscoring the need for continued advancements.
The post SemiAnalysis unveils GDPx benchmark, and the best AI model scores 12% appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: SemiAnalysis has introduced the GDPx benchmark to evaluate artificial intelligence models. Results show that even the top-performing AI model achieved a score of only 12%. This low performance highlights the early and developing stage of general agentic capabilities in artificial intelligence, pointing out that significant advancements are still required before AI systems can achieve high-level autonomy.
content_ta: SemiAnalysis நிறுவனம் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) மாடல்களை மதிப்பிடுவதற்காக புதிய GDPx benchmark-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இதில் சிறந்த AI மாடல் கூட வெறும் 12% மதிப்பெண் மட்டுமே பெற்றுள்ளது. இந்த குறைந்த செயல் திறன், செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவின் பொதுவான ஏஜென்டிக் திறன்கள் இன்னும் ஆரம்ப நிலையிலேயே உள்ளன என்பதை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது.

title: HSBC plans Hong Kong AI research institute with blockchain and post-quantum focus
summary:
HSBC's new institute could bolster Hong Kong's fintech ecosystem, enhance regional AI leadership, and influence global digital asset security.
The post HSBC plans Hong Kong AI research institute with blockchain and post-quantum focus appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: HSBC is planning to establish a new artificial intelligence research institute in Hong Kong. The proposed center will focus on blockchain technology and post-quantum security measures. Industry experts believe the initiative could significantly strengthen the region's financial technology sector, boost local artificial intelligence leadership, and contribute to global digital asset security developments.
content_ta: Hong Kong-ல் ஒரு புதிய செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு ஆராய்ச்சி மையத்தை நிறுவ HSBC திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. இந்த மையம் பிளாக்சைன் தொழில்நுட்பம் மற்றும் போஸ்ட்-குவாண்டம் பாதுகாப்பு நடவடிக்கைகளில் கவனம் செலுத்தும். இந்த முயற்சியானது இப்பகுதியின் தொழில்நுட்பத் துறையை வலுப்படுத்தவும், உலகளாவிய டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து பாதுகாப்பிற்கு உதவவும் கூடும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Pendle becomes second-largest DeFi venue for tokenized stocks with 17% share
summary:
Pendle's rapid ascent in DeFi tokenized stocks highlights the volatile yet transformative potential of decentralized finance innovations.

content: Pendle has rapidly grown to become the second-largest decentralized finance platform for tokenized stocks, capturing a 17 percent market share. This significant milestone highlights the ongoing evolution and transformative impact of decentralized finance innovations within the digital asset sector.
content_ta: Pendle தற்பொழுது tokenized stocks-களுக்கான இரண்டாவது பெரிய DeFi தளமாக வேகமாக வளர்ந்து, 17 சதவீதம் சந்தைப் பங்கைப் பெற்றுள்ளது. இந்த குறிப்பிடத்தக்க மைல்கல், டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துத் துறையில் decentralized finance புதுமைகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான பரிணாம வளர்ச்சியையும் மாற்றத்தக்க தாக்கத்தையும் எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: Bhutan partners with 3iQ to manage sovereign Bitcoin holdings
summary:
Bhutan's move to actively manage Bitcoin holdings could set a precedent for other nations, highlighting the evolving role of digital assets in sovereign wealth.
The post Bhutan partners with 3iQ to manage sovereign Bitcoin holdings appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Bhutan has partnered with digital asset manager 3iQ to actively manage its sovereign Bitcoin holdings. This strategic move highlights the growing role of digital assets in national wealth management and could establish a precedent for other governments looking to handle cryptocurrency reserves.
content_ta: தங்களது sovereign Bitcoin இருப்பை தீவிரமாக நிர்வகிக்க 3iQ உடன் Bhutan கூட்டு சேர்ந்துள்ளது. தேசிய செல்வ மேலாண்மையில் digital assetகளின் வளர்ந்து வரும் பங்கை இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது மற்றும் பிற நாடுகளுக்கும் ஒரு முன்னுதாரணமாக திகழலாம்.

title: How Varsity Tech Runs a Systematic Fund with Three People
summary:
Varsity Tech founder Daniel Tan on a Singapore fund where AI agents do the research and backtesting, and three people hold the risk limits and kill switch.
The post How Varsity Tech Runs a Systematic Fund with Three People appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Varsity Tech founder Daniel Tan discusses how the Singapore-based fund operates systematically using AI agents for research and backtesting. The lean team of three people manages risk limits and controls the kill switch, highlighting a modern approach to fund management.
content_ta: Singapore-வைச் சேர்ந்த ஃபண்ட் நிறுவனமான Varsity Tech-ன் founder Daniel Tan, AI agents மூலம் research மற்றும் backtesting செய்து தங்கள் fund எவ்வாறு இயங்குகிறது என்பதை விவரிக்கிறார். மூன்று பேர் கொண்ட இந்த சிறிய குழு risk limits மற்றும் kill switch-ஐ நிர்வகிக்கிறது.

title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
summary: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.
content: Following a major exploit, the hacker's wallets holding stolen Bitcoin have received numerous small transactions. Rather than large-scale transfers, the addresses are being flooded with micro-payments worth less than a dollar. Each transaction includes a message, featuring personal pleas for financial help, laundering pitches, and promotional tokens sent by strangers hoping to reach the attacker.
content_ta: ஒரு பெரிய பாதுகாப்பு மீறலைத் தொடர்ந்து, ஹேக்கரின் வாலட்களில் இருக்கும் ஸ்டென் செய்யப்பட்ட Bitcoin-களுக்கு பல சிறிய பரிவர்த்தனைகள் வந்துள்ளன. பெரிய அளவிலான பரிவர்த்தனைகளுக்குப் பதிலாக, ஒரு டாலருக்கும் குறைவான மதிப்புள்ள சிறிய தொகைகள் அந்த முகவரிகளுக்கு அனுப்பப்படுகின்றன. ஒவ்வொரு பரிவர்த்தனையுடனும் ஒரு செய்தியும் இணைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது; அதில் நிதி உதவி கோரும் வேண்டுகோள்கள், பணமோசடி தொடர்பான ஆலோசனைகள் மற்றும் தாக்குபவரைத் தொடர்பு கொள்ள விரும்பும் அந்நியர்களின் விளம்பர டோக்கன்களும் அடங்கும்.

title: Bitcoin claws back toward $79,000 as markets shake off crypto's biggest hack
summary: ZEC led the majors and oil slid on a report that Trump wants to give Iran diplomacy more time, with U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday.
content: Bitcoin climbed back toward $79,000 as financial markets recovered from a major cryptocurrency hack. Meanwhile, oil prices declined following reports regarding diplomatic approaches toward Iran ahead of upcoming elections.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை $79,000 நெருங்கி மீண்டு வந்தது. பெரிய அளவிலான crypto hack-க்குப் பிறகு சந்தைகள் மீண்டு வருவதால் இந்த உயர்வு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், தேர்தலை முன்னிட்டு Iran விவகாரத்தில் ராஜதந்திர முயற்சிகளுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கப்படுவதாக வெளியான தகவல்களால் oil விலைகள் சரிந்தன.

title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
summary: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.
content: BTCPay, a popular bitcoin payment tool, has advised its users to shut down their servers following reports of drained wallets. The open-source project is currently investigating the issue and has not yet provided a total loss figure or a fix. The project's founder indicated that the reported security incidents appear to affect software versions older than 2.4.2.
content_ta: பிட்காயின் பேமெண்ட் டூலான BTCPay, வாலட்கள் காலியாகியுள்ளதாக வந்த புகார்களைத் தொடர்ந்து, பயனர்கள் தங்கள் சர்வர்களை தற்காலிகமாக அணைத்து வைக்குமாறு அறிவுறுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த ஓப்பன் சோர்ஸ் திட்டம் தற்போது இது குறித்து விசாரித்து வருவதுடன், இழப்புத் தொகை குறித்த விவரங்களையோ அல்லது தீர்ர்வையோ இன்னும் வெளியிடவில்லை. பதிப்பு 2.4.2-க்கு முந்தைய வெர்ஷன்களில்தான் இந்தச் சிக்கல் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதாகத் தெரிகிறது என்று இதன் நிறுவனர் தெரிவித்துள்ளார்.

title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
summary: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.
content: BTCPay Server has issued an urgent warning to operators running outdated software to shut down their servers immediately. The alert follows reports of unauthorized attackers successfully draining funds from hot wallets. Users are advised to secure their systems and update software to prevent further security breaches and financial losses.
content_ta: பழைய சாஃப்ட்வேரைப் பயன்படுத்தி வரும் BTCPay Server ஆப்பரேட்டர்கள் உடனடியாக தங்கள் சர்வர்களை முடக்க வேண்டும் என்று எச்சரிக்கை விடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. ஹாட் வாலட்களில் இருந்து அனுமதியின்றி நிதி திருடப்படுவதாக வந்த புகார்களைத் தொடர்ந்து இந்த எச்சரிக்கை வந்துள்ளது. மேலும் பாதுகாப்பு மீறல்கள் மற்றும் நிதி இழப்புகளைத் தவிர்க்க பயனர்கள் தங்கள் சிஸ்டம்களைப் பாதுகாக்குமாறு அறிவுறுத்தப்படுகிறார்கள்.

title: Bank of Korea probes financial firms’ exposure to crypto risks
summary:
The Bank of Korea's survey could lead to enhanced regulatory measures, impacting financial stability and crypto market integration strategies.
The post Bank of Korea quizzes 31 financial firms on crypto shock scenarios appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The Bank of Korea has launched a survey involving 31 financial firms to assess their exposure to cryptocurrency-related risks and potential shock scenarios. This initiative highlights growing regulatory scrutiny in the financial sector regarding digital assets. The findings could potentially lead to enhanced regulatory measures, significantly impacting financial stability and the broader integration strategies of the crypto market.
content_ta: Bank of Korea, crypto சம்பந்தப்பட்ட அபாயங்கள் மற்றும் அதிர்ச்சி சூழ்நிலைகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிதி நிறுவனங்களின் தயார்நிலை குறித்து ஆய்வு செய்ய 31 நிதி நிறுவனங்களிடம் விசாரணை நடத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த நடவடிக்கை டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்கள் தொடர்பான ஒழுங்குமுறை சோதனைகள் அதிகரித்து வருவதைக் காட்டுகிறது. இதன் முடிவுகள் நிதி ஸ்திரத்தன்மை மற்றும் crypto சந்தை ஒருங்கிணைப்பு உத்திகளை பாதிக்கக்கூடிய புதிய ஒழுங்குமுறை நடவடிக்கைகளுக்கு வழிவகுக்கலாம்.

title: Ambire Ice Puts Safe Owner Changes and Approval Thresholds on the Signing Screen
summary: Ambire says its Ice hardware wallet will decode Safe transactions and flag changes to account control. The design targets the decisions signers make before authorizing an action.
content: Ambire has announced that its Ice hardware wallet will feature transaction decoding for Safe accounts. title: Allica Bank Pays £100 Million in Interest to Business Current Account Customers as High-Street Savings Gap Persists
summary:
Allica Bank, the challenger bank built for established businesses, has now paid more than £100 million in savings interest to its business current account customers, marking a major milestone in its mission to give British businesses a better deal from their bank.
The interest has been paid through the instant-access Savings Pots attached to Allica's Business Rewards Account, which allow businesses to earn interest on their excess cash without having to lock it away. More than half of that interest has been paid in 2026 alone, as Allica continues to scale its business current account proposition, launched in 2023. This is in addition to the £79.3 million of interest established businesses have been paid through Allica’s conventional savings accounts.
Many businesses will set aside significant sums of excess cash for an upcoming tax bill, a property purchase deposit, to fund a growth initiative, or just as a rainy-day fund, yet they often struggle to get a decent return on that cash.
The milestone highlights the potential returns available to businesses willing to look beyond traditional high-street banks. Allica's analysis of six major banking providers found that the average instant-access savings rate available on a £75,000 business deposit was just 0.80% AER.*
By comparison, through Allica’s Business Rewards Account, it offers a standard Savings Pot rate of 2.83% AER – more than three times that amount – and rewards eligible customers with the ability to unlock additional interest boosts. The maximum advertised rate, including conditional and time-limited boosts, is currently 4.08% AER.
Allica has prioritised giving businesses a decent return on their cash since it launched its business bank account in 2023. Research it published in 2024 estimated that UK SMEs were missing out on £9 billion a year in potential savings interest, with billions of pounds held in accounts paying little or no interest.
The milestone comes amid a period of strong growth in Allica's established business customer base. The number of businesses using its Business Rewards Account increased by 133% in 2025, reaching more than 14,000, just two years after the account launched.
Designed exclusively for established businesses with between 5 and 250 employees, Allica’s Business Rewards Account is designed to be powerful and rewarding, also offering cashback on card payments, integrations with accounting software, expense cards for team members with limits and controls, and the support of a relationship manager.
Richard Davies, Allica Bank’s CEO, said, “Established businesses have been getting a poor deal on their cash from the big banks for too long. These are businesses working hard to grow, create jobs and support their local economies. They shouldn't have to settle for their hard-earned money doing so little for them.
“Paying our customers more than £100 million in interest from their Savings Pots shows what's possible when you build a bank specifically to support established businesses. This is real money going back into the hands of businesses who are such critical part of the UK economy and their local communities
“And with more businesses choosing Allica, it's clear there's an appetite for a different kind of business banking. We're showing that businesses don't have to accept the way things have always been done.”

title: Secret SantAI? Visa Survey Finds Americans Quietly Turning to AI for Holiday Shopping Help
summary:
There may be a Secret Sant-AI behind your presents this year. New Visa research finds 41% of Americans wouldn't tell someone that AI helped choose their gift, as more shoppers quietly hand AI the job of finding gifts and tracking down deals. More than half of U.S. adults (54%) have already used AI for at least one shopping task, up from 47% last year.
The findings come from Visa's 2026 Holiday Spending Shift Survey, which polled more than 1,000 U.S. adults in late September in a survey commissioned by Morning Consult. The data paints a picture of consumers juggling persistent cost pressures, evolving technology and heightened fraud concerns, while still finding ways to check every box on their gift lists.
“Consumers are approaching the holidays with both value and security in mind,” said Michael Brown, principal U.S. economist at Visa. “They’re looking for deals, experimenting with tools like AI and changing how they shop in response to fraud concerns. It’s a consumer who is adapting as the shopping experience itself continues to change.”
AI Becomes a Holiday Helper 
Shoppers are most comfortable handing AI the practical tasks: comparing prices (61%), checking availability (59%), finding discounts (57%) and suggesting gift ideas (54%). Nearly a quarter say they're more comfortable using AI for shopping than they were last year.
Gen Z is leading the shift. More than eight in 10 young consumers are open to AI assistance, and 73% would let it suggest gift ideas — 19 points higher than adults overall.
But there's a gap between browsing and buying. While consumers are increasingly comfortable using AI assistants for discovery, research and decision-making, trusting one to make a purchase is a bigger leap — only 23% of U.S. consumers trust GenAI to handle payment transactions on their behalf, according to Visa's Trust Index. It's a familiar pattern: the technology often arrives before consumers fully trust the experience, similar to when payments moved online and again when commerce went mobile.
What shifts the equation? Familiar brands. The Trust Index found that 61% of consumers trust Visa to secure an AI-powered payment — rising to 68% among 18–34-year-olds and 71% among weekly AI users. As agentic commerce grows, that confidence may be what bridges the gap between AI as a shopping assistant and AI as a shopping agent.
Shoppers Stretch Budgets as Costs Stay Top of Mind
Cost-conscious shopping isn't going anywhere. Eighty-four percent of consumers say they've taken at least one action to manage higher everyday costs in the past year — most commonly hunting for discounts (47%), cutting discretionary spending (35%) and trading down to lower-cost brands (33%).
Gen Z is getting creative. More than a third started shopping earlier this year to spread out the financial hit, compared to 23% of all adults.
Experiences Top Wish Lists, But Physical Gifts Win Wallets
Besides cash, when it comes to gifts, Americans are dreaming of experiences. Travel (60%) and live-event tickets (55%) top the list of what people are most excited to give or receive.
But actually buying gifts tells a different story. Only 15% of respondents are prioritizing experiences, while 27% are focused on physical items. Gen Z comes closest to aligning their wallets with their wishes-- 39% are splitting spending evenly between the two, compared to 26% of all adults.
World Cup Fever Shapes Gift-Giving
The 2026 FIFA World Cup is leaving its mark on holiday lists. Nearly a third of Americans say the tournament has boosted their interest in sports-related gifts, a figure that climbs to about half among households earning $100,000 or more and adults under 35.
Cross-Border Shopping Goes Mainstream
Three in 10 Americans expect to buy at least one gift from an overseas seller this season. Among Gen Z, it's more than half.
The draw isn't just price. Quality (32%) and uniqueness (31%) are the top reasons shoppers are looking beyond U.S. borders, ahead of better deals (25%).
Gen Z and Cross-Border Senders Warm to Stablecoins and Crypto
Stablecoins are still new to many Americans, but more than half (56%) see a benefit, rising to 77% of Gen Z. Among Americans who send money abroad, 51% say that after seeing the benefits, they are likely to use stablecoins in the next year.
Crypto resonates with the same groups. Half of those who send money abroad (51%) call it a useful way to do so, against 26% of adults. Gen Z is more comfortable shopping with a retailer that accepts crypto (34% vs. 25%). 
Fraud Concerns Drive Behavior Change
The convenience of digital shopping comes with growing unease about scams. Nearly three in 10 shoppers say they were targeted by fraud during last year's holiday season, a figure that rises to 39% among Gen Z.
In response, three-quarters of Americans have changed how they shop: enabling two-factor authentication (34%), changing passwords more often (34%), declining to save payment details (25%), switching from debit to credit cards (24%) and using digital wallets (21%).
"Consumers are navigating a lot this season, from higher costs, new technology and real concerns about fraud," said Brown. "But they're adapting. They're hunting for deals, shopping smarter and staying alert. That resilience is the real story."

title: Liberis and Qred Complete Merger Following Regulatory Approval to Create Global SMB Financial Platform
summary:
Liberis, a leading global embedded finance platform, and Qred, one of Europe’s foremost digital small business banks, today announced the completion of their merger, first announced in June 2026, following approval from the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (SFSA).
The merger combines Qred’s regulated banking capability and direct relationships with small businesses with Liberis’s embedded finance technology and distribution through more than 30 partners, including Deliveroo, Vagaro and Nexi. The group serves more than 60,000 small businesses across 17 countries and has access to approximately 11.5 million addressable merchants.
Qred’s deposit-funded banking model and direct customer relationships complement Liberis’s partner-led distribution. Together, the businesses bring two routes to small business finance: through a regulated bank and through platforms that businesses already use.
The group’s ambition is to broaden the financial services available to small businesses and its partners over time.
Emil Sunvisson, Founder and CEO of Qred, becomes Group CEO of the combined business, with Rob Fairfield, CEO of Liberis, becoming Deputy CEO. Both businesses will continue to operate under their existing brands for now. Existing partner integrations, products and customer relationships will continue as they do today. Further details on the group’s product development and longer-term brand plans will be shared as they are finalised.
Supporting the businesses that drive local economies
Small businesses account for around 90% of companies worldwide and generate more than two-thirds of global employment, yet face a financing gap estimated in the trillions of dollars as traditional bank lending continues to retreat from the smallest firms.
Liberis’s December 2025 Impact Report, based on a survey of more than 1,700 funded merchants across the UK and US, found that 76% of respondents had previously been rejected by traditional lenders at least once before coming to Liberis. Forty-two per cent said Liberis funding had helped them create or save at least one job. 
Emil Sunvisson, Group CEO, said: “We’re not challenging banks. We’re challenging the way the system finances small businesses. Too often, lending decisions rely on backwards-looking credit scores and paperwork that takes weeks a business doesn’t have. We use the data a business generates every day to understand its needs. Advances in AI are helping us do this faster and at greater scale, giving more small businesses a fair and timely funding decision. Bringing a regulated bank together with an embedded finance network lets us reach more businesses and go further than lending alone. Our ambition is to become the financial operating system small businesses never have to leave. We power small businesses that power everything else.”
Backing the next phase of growth
Emil Anderson, Partner, Nordic Capital Advisors, "SMBs are the economic engine of global commerce, yet they remain systematically underserved by legacy financial institutions. Bringing Qred and Liberis together establishes an unrivalled category leader in SMB fintech. Nordic Capital is proud to support this combined team as they scale their technology, expand into new markets, and drive financial inclusion for entrepreneurs globally."
